name: Rewilding Innovation Fund
summary: Grants of up to £15,000 for Rewilding Network projects in Britain, covering 40+ hectares or any marine project, to fund plans, feasibility work, community engagement, expertise and technology. Capital works are excluded.
reporting: Supported projects report on their progress every quarter and share stories and lessons learnt with the Rewilding Network and the public.

calls.label: Next round

status.quote: Complete the application form for the Rewilding Innovation Fund when the next round is open.

recurring.quote: We currently have two rounds per year, typically one in the summer and one at new year.

calls.recurring: Two rounds a year, typically summer and new year

applicant_types.quote: You're a member of the Rewilding Network. This includes, but is not limited to, community, private and public landowners and managers of rewilding areas on the land and sea.

geography.quote: based in Britain (England, Wales and Scotland)

access.quote: Complete the application form for the Rewilding Innovation Fund when the next round is open.

window.quote: Projects have two opportunities to apply for funding through the Rewilding Innovation Fund each year, in the new year and summer.

amount.quote: Funding for up to £15,000* will be considered. We expect the majority of grants to be less than £10,000.

reporting.quote: All supported projects must measure and report on their progress every quarter. All successful applicants must agree to share stories and lessons learnt for the wider Rewilding Network and for the public.
